subject: English
question_text: The graph below shows the choice of profession by
stimulus: different educated people. Describe the graph in 150 words. 10
guide_solution: Graph & charts The graph shows the choice of profession by different educated people. Educated people prefer Govt. Job, farming and Business. A lion share of educated people like Govt. job. The participant in Govt. Job is 80%. It far outnumbers the other professions. Then only 50% educated people like to run business. It is 30% less than Govt. Job. On the other hand less educated people prefer farming. It is only 20% so Govt. job gets the highest professional value wherever farming gets the lowest. However the difference between the highest and the lowest preference is 60%. 186
